notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing any other creature, adding {R}.
The creature dies, triggering Liliana, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
